# RefineCV

> RefineCV is an AI-powered resume analyzer and ATS resume checker providing evidence-grounded resume evaluations, role-specific job matching, side-by-side resume comparisons, and interview question preparation.

RefineCV is a web-based resume intelligence platform. Candidates can upload a PDF resume without creating an account and receive structured diagnostic feedback, ATS compatibility insights, actionable bullet point makeovers, head-to-head resume comparisons, and grounded interview preparation to defend their experience.

## Public Tools & Pages

- [RefineCV Home](https://refinecv-vl93.onrender.com/): Platform overview, feature breakdown, and access to RefineCV tools.
- [Analyze Resume](https://refinecv-vl93.onrender.com/analyze): Resume diagnostic evaluation, ATS readability assessment, and targeted job description matching.
- [Compare Resumes](https://refinecv-vl93.onrender.com/compare): Side-by-side comparison of two PDF resumes with category scoring and winner verdict.
- [Interview Prep from CV](https://refinecv-vl93.onrender.com/interview-prep): Interview questions grounded in claims written in the resume, with risk levels and practice answer evaluation.

## Key Capabilities & Workflows

- Resume Analysis: Evaluates overall resume strength, structure, ATS readability, strengths, weaknesses, and actionable improvements.
- General Diagnostic: Provides a holistic assessment of resume quality and identifies concrete improvement areas.
- Specific Job Matching: Compares a resume against a user-provided job description to identify role alignment and keyword gaps.
- Grounded Improvements: Suggests concrete bullet point improvements based on stated candidate experience without intentionally inventing candidate facts.
- Resume Comparison: Compares two resumes across Impact, Skills, Relevance, and Structure.
- Interview Preparation: Generates interview questions mapped to claims in the resume and supports practice answer evaluation.
- PDF Text Extraction and OCR: Extracts resume content from PDFs and can use OCR for scanned resume pages.
- Real-Time Processing: Provides processing progress through the application's interface.

## Technical & Privacy Constraints

- Supported format: PDF only.
- Maximum PDF size: 5MB.
- Maximum PDF pages: 20.
- OCR processing is limited to 3 scanned pages per document.
- No account, password, or email registration is required.
- Analysis sessions are stored transiently in memory and expire after 30 minutes.
- Resumes are not permanently hosted or indexed by RefineCV.
- User-specific result and history pages are private/ephemeral and should not be treated as public content.
